build_DPTOri_dense_prediction: build a DPTOri model to fuse multi-layer ViT features into dense prediction output feature maps
build_DPTOri_with_depth_head: build a DPTOri model with depth=True to predict inverse depth alongside dense features
create_ResidualConvUnit: create a ResidualConvUnit module that applies two convolutions with ReLU and adds a residual connection
create_FeatureFusionBlock: create a FeatureFusionBlock to fuse features with optional skip connections using residual conv units
create_Interpolate_module: create an Interpolate module that wraps nn.functional.interpolate with configurable scale factor and mode
